free_tier.stated: Free: 2 TB of storage and 50 GB of new uploads a month. Community (free while in their Telegram channel): unlimited storage and 200 GB of new uploads a month. Paid plans start at $9 a month and add the API.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-file size limit for uploads from the browser, saves from a link, torrents or cloud imports; imports from video sites stop at 2 GB a video and files sent through the Telegram bot are limited by Telegram.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: No egress fee on any plan: 'Browsing, streaming, sharing and downloading never cost credits on any plan.' No bandwidth meter is documented.

tooling: No API on Free or Community ('API No' in the plan table). Pro is $9 a month ($90 for 12 months) with unlimited storage, 2 TB of uploads a month and the API; Max is $50 a month ($500 for 12 months) with unlimited storage and unlimited monthly uploads. Bulk paths on Free are torrent import and URL or cloud-drive import, both credit-metered.
chaining: Community tier provides unlimited cumulative storage with a limit of 200 GB of new uploads per month after joining the vendor Telegram channel.

limits.value: new uploads: 50 GB a month on Free and 200 GB a month on Community; Community storage is unlimited only while the account is in the Telegram channel, otherwise the cap is 2 TB

limits_note: Free: 2 TB, 50 GB of uploads a month, 1 upload at a time, 100 files per torrent. Community: unlimited storage, 200 GB of uploads a month, 1 upload at a time, 500 files per torrent. Credits: 50 to start, plus 200 once for linking Telegram and joining the channel; torrent add 2, cloud import 1, zip extract 2, copy 10. Leaving the channel returns the account to Free; nothing is deleted and new uploads stop while the account holds more than 2 TB.

identity_cost.detail: Sign up with Google, GitHub or an e-mail address; no credit card is needed. Unlimited storage also needs a linked Telegram account and membership of the Telegram channel.

reliability_note: The unlimited tier lasts only while the account is in the Telegram channel; leaving returns it to Free (2 TB) and new uploads stop while the account holds more than 2 TB, with nothing deleted. At 200 GB of new uploads a month, 20 TiB needs about 110 months. The API is not on Free or Community. A POST to /createAcc answered HTTP 400 'Verification required. Please verify your identity first.' on 2026-10-21.

extras.verified_at_basis: deepstorage.dev/pricing and deepstorage.dev/ were read on 2026-11-03: plan table, channel-membership rule and sign-up sentence.
extras.quota_verbatim: Free: 2 TB. Community (join their Telegram channel): storage becomes 'Unlimited, while you are in the channel'. Both have no per-file size limit.
extras.limits_verbatim: Free 2 TB / 200 GB monthly uploads (Community) / 1 upload at a time / 500 files per torrent. Credits: 50 on signup, +200 once for linking Telegram; torrent add 2, cloud import 1, zip extract 2, copy 10. Storage is re-checked — leaving the channel drops you to 2 TB and blocks new uploads above it, without deleting anything.
extras.egress_verbatim: No egress fee on any plan: 'Browsing, streaming, sharing and downloading never cost credits on any plan.' No bandwidth meter is documented.
extras.chaining_verbatim: Unlimited storage behind a single free action (join a Telegram channel) is the cleanest free-tier gate found in this slot. Chain = 1 account with unlimited storage, but only 200 GB of *new* uploads per month on Community, so accumulation is slow rather than blocked.
extras.tooling_verbatim: No public API on free/Community ('API: No' in the plan table); API access starts at Pro $9. Bulk paths on free are torrent import and URL/cloud-drive import, both credit-metered.
extras.agent_focus: regional and non-English large-file hosts, especially very large single-file caps with no total-storage limit

binding_note: new-upload volume is capped at 200 GB a month on Community (50 GB on Free), so filling a large archive takes years even though stored bytes are unlimited
